name: Ato 1% de Unmei no Koi
source:
“When are you getting married?”
When you’re finding the reality of your romantic life too bleak to bare,
you’re matched through an app to a man with a 99% compatibility rating. A riveting date, his eye-opening kiss… Your love only picks up speed… Until your 1% mismatch makes you hit the brakes.
”I’ll prove that we’re a perfect match.”
Just 1% left… Who could be the man of your destiny?
translation:
“你什么时候结婚？”
当你发现你的浪漫生活的现实太惨淡而无法裸露时，
你通过应用程序与一位匹配度高达99% 的男士相匹配。一次引人入胜的约会，他令人大开眼界的吻……你们的爱情只会加速……直到百分之一的不匹配让你踩刹车。
“我会证明我们是绝配。”
只剩下1%了……谁会是你的命中注定的人呢？
